reference_sql:
WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend rows in the period
  SELECT c.channel_id, c.campaign_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.campaign_id
),
cutoffs AS (  -- one row per channel: its 75th percentile of campaign spend
  SELECT channel_id, percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY spend) AS p75_spend
  FROM campaign_spend
  GROUP BY channel_id
)
SELECT cs.channel_id, cs.campaign_id, cs.spend
FROM campaign_spend cs
JOIN cutoffs ct ON ct.channel_id = cs.channel_id
WHERE cs.spend >= ct.p75_spend

  SELECT c.channel_id, c.campaign_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend

WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend rows in the period
  SELECT c.channel_id, c.campaign_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.campaign_id
),
with_cut AS (  -- one row per campaign, with its channel's 75th percentile
  SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, spend,
         quantile_cont(spend, 0.75) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id) AS p75_spend
  FROM campaign_spend
)
SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, spend
FROM with_cut
WHERE spend >= p75_spend

solver.query:
WITH camp AS (
  SELECT c.channel_id, s.campaign_id, SUM(s.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily s
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = s.campaign_id
  WHERE s.spend_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND s.spend_date <= DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, s.campaign_id
), p AS (
  SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, spend,
         QUANTILE_CONT(spend, 0.75) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id) AS p75
  FROM camp
)
SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, spend
FROM p
WHERE spend >= p75
